native_rules: Coin.AddExtra executes first, then Session.extraCoins is stored. The native order is Madness remaining, Lightning remaining, PropellerRush5*n, Clash remaining, separate super-lightball lookup, Clash remaining specials, Lightning for board lightballs, mission counters and special-item-id clear.
Madness queries event validity even for nonpositive remaining counts, adds only positive valid counts, applies native difficulty multiplier and factor5, and has no table-game gate in this method.

Lightning remaining contributes5*n, board lightballs20*n; super lightball doubles each before the existing event/difficulty/table gates. All three super-lightball lookups in the composed Session end are required even with locked events.

Clash totals typed remaining-special counts with rocket/propeller/TNT/lightball score weights, doubles only the lightball weight for super lightball, then applies remaining-special multiplier through the existing score sink. All arithmetic retains signed32-bit overflow.

If the Madness icon is shown and event type is3, mission propeller count receives the full remaining count. Otherwise rocket then TNT receive signed remaining/2 truncated toward zero. Mission counters apply the native signed-byte difficulty multiplier.

The real session extraCoins field, Coin before/after snapshot and mission counters now update in formal-scene conversion/skip checks. The prior direct verifier Coin.AddExtra call has been replaced by the actual runtime Session method.

Formal-scene event availability remains an explicit locked first-board fixture. Actual Madness/Lightning/PropellerRush/Clash snapshot classes execute their native gates and receive no locked-event progression; unexpected bundle/pool/score-owner access throws.

Native differential covers220 session protocol/partial-failure cases,160 Madness,20 Lightning remaining,20 board-lightball,150 mission multiplier and160 Clash weighting/null/overflow cases. Protocol event calls, event validity, dictionaries, context and score sinks are explicitly bounded.
